facts.fact: 午宴的真相：不是叙旧，是 Reds 的凯旋检阅——她们过得越好，Peyton 的权力叙事越完整。
facts.anchor: This brunch isn’t so much about everyone rekindling old friendships as it is about the Reds showing off

facts.fact: Sienna 四年高中的日常：储物柜被红色记号笔涂满「trailer trash」与恶毒恐同蔑称——Sydney 的储物柜就在隔壁。
facts.anchor: finding nasty little decorations scrawled across hers in red Sharpie.

facts.fact: Max 的判词：四年如一日羞辱 Sienna 的真凶是 Sydney——Jordan 只配在旁喝彩，脏不了自己的手。
facts.anchor: there was only one person vicious enough to put that much time and effort into tormenting my friend.

facts.fact: Sydney 与 Brooke 当场互撕：trad wife/second-rate car salesman/「Cow」对「Whore」——Reds 内部早已互相看不上。
facts.anchor: “If you’re going to grow a backbone after all these years, at least have the balls to own it.”

facts.fact: Jordan 之死成了媒体事件：全电台都在播，ACC 全上午跟进——她若活着会为此乐上云霄。
facts.anchor: I couldn’t find a single station that wasn’t talking about her.

facts.fact: Max 作呕的结论：朋友尸骨未寒，Reds 正当面拆解她——有这种朋友，谁还需要敌人。
facts.anchor: Her body isn’t even in the ground yet, and here they are, picking her apart.

facts.fact: Reds 六人最终集结：Peyton 携左右手 Misty、Delaney 压轴入场，Max 拳头攥到指甲掐进手套。
facts.anchor: Delaney, Misty, and the queen bee herself, Peyton, walk into the garden.

facts.fact: 章底自白：她们当年确实打碎了她——她以为胶水粘好了所有碎片，如今发现漏了几块，而且知道是哪几块。
facts.anchor: I know they did. I just thought I’d done a pretty good job of gluing all the broken pieces back together again.
